action_visual: the next day, Gu Shen in his grey suit returns and sits at the same counter seat, ordering the same americano plus a croissant, taking two bites before setting it down
source_text: 第二天，灰色西装的男人又来了

action_visual: Su Nian stares at the coffee cup, watching the condensation bead on the glass just like yesterday
source_text: 苏念盯着那杯咖啡。杯壁上的水汽正在凝结

action_visual: Su Nian takes a deep breath, picks up the cup and takes a sip, closing her eyes
source_text: 她深吸一口气，端起来，喝了一口

action_visual: the world falls silent, all sound draining away, leaving only a low voice heard as if through a wall
inner_voice: ……前女友说我不懂感情。也许她说得对。但我也不懂为什么隔壁那家破咖啡店的咖啡比星巴克好喝……不对，我在想什么，我是来谈收购的……
source_text: 世界安静了。前女友说我不懂感情……我是来谈收购的

action_visual: Su Nian sets the cup down abruptly, her heart racing as she realizes he wants to acquire the shop
source_text: 苏念放下杯子，心跳加速。收购。他要收购念想

action_visual: Su Nian looks at her left hand; the burn scar on her ring finger remains, but the small paper-cut mark on the side of her index finger has vanished, the skin now smooth as if never wounded
focus_object: smooth skin where the scar was on her index finger
source_text: 食指侧面那个纸划伤的小痕迹消失了。光滑得像从未受过伤

action_visual: Su Nian's stomach tightens; she remembers the memory itself still exists but the scar is gone, and this is wrong
source_text: 这段记忆还在，但伤痕本身没了。这不对

action_visual: Su Nian looks up as Gu Shen stands at the counter holding out a business card
spoken_dialogue: 你好。我叫顾深。对面写字楼的。你们店有没有考虑过合作？
source_text: 我叫顾深。对面写字楼的。有没有考虑过合作

action_visual: Su Nian takes the card, reads the gold letters — Gu Shen, Partner, Ruijian Investment — and looks into his grey eyes like an overcast sky
source_text: 烫金的字：顾深，合伙人，锐见投资。不考虑

action_visual: Gu Shen pauses, then gives a faint smile, the corner of his mouth moving barely a millimeter, then turns and leaves
source_text: 顾深愣了一下，然后笑了——很浅。好吧。他转身走了

action_visual: Su Nian reaches for a rag with her right hand; her fingers touch smooth skin where the small mole on the back of her hand used to be, now gone, replaced by unblemished skin
focus_object: smooth skin where the mole vanished on her hand
source_text: 右手手背那颗从小就在的小痣，不见了

action_visual: the tap keeps running, water sound filling the whole shop; Su Nian turns it off and the shop falls suddenly silent as if behind a wall
source_text: 水龙头还在流。苏念关掉水龙头。店里突然安静得像隔了一面墙
